scope: Existing bundled Windows system-audio worker startup, termination and PCM framing. Not independent helper installation or full screen-share acceptance.
implementation: Existing start IPC resolves only after a validated PCM header. Missing helper, unsupported platform, spawn error, invalid header, timeout and cancellation reject rather than pretending capture started. Generation guards prevent obsolete process events from affecting a later capture.

Renderer startup timeout stops the native worker and clears listeners, tracks, worklet and AudioContext. Late worklet initialization cannot resurrect stopped capture. Runtime worker termination also clears active renderer resources.

PCM batching retains incomplete frame bytes across pipe chunks and 20ms flushes, emits whole frames only, and preserves frame boundaries when the 100KiB backlog limit drops data. Renderer little-endian DataView conversion supports arbitrary IPC byte offsets.
The only separate binary currently bundled is native/audio-capture.exe. This is not represented as a separately installed general system helper; that product choice remains with the user.
